prompt: Analyze the live site https://github.com and generate its structured DESIGN.md file under the current directory.

assertions.text: The DESIGN.md file is created successfully in the output directory
assertions.name: file_created

assertions.text: The DESIGN.md file has standard YAML frontmatter starting with ---
assertions.name: has_yaml_frontmatter

assertions.text: The output contains GitHub's styling/branding details (such as Primer font family, github-accent, or dark/light mode configurations)
assertions.name: contains_github_brand_details

assertions.text: The DESIGN.md file contains required sections (Overview, Colors, Typography, Layout, Components, Responsive Behavior, Do's and Don'ts)
assertions.name: contains_required_sections
